title: Why does soreness hit 2 days later? 😖
caption:
It is called DOMS. Tiny damage, then swelling and repair make nerves extra sensitive, peaking around 24-72 hours. It is strongest after new exercises and lowering reps, and it fades as you adapt. Worst DOMS you ever had? 👇

Why Does This Happen? #13
